label: Exposed — bare branches
location: The Verdant Ward, the nesting rows
injuries: Sap spent from holding the screens
Leaves gone thin and yellow out of season

recentEvents.value: The screens failed like a tree in a hard frost; he looked at her bare branches and called it evil revealing weakness.

unresolvedConflicts.value: There is nothing here that belongs to him — only young green things that belong to themselves.

temporaryObjective.value: Ask the smallest thing a garden can ask.
